_about: Hand-written card facts, keyed by NORAD id. 'fact' shows on the card; 'stats' can override the third stat. Keep every fact true and checkable. Objects without an entry get a computed fact (see js/lore.js).

25544.title: International Space Station
25544.fact: It's about the size of a football field and flies at **28,000 km/h**. It could cross Canada in about 12 minutes.

48274.title: Tiangong Space Station
48274.fact: China's own space station. Its name means **Heavenly Palace**, and astronauts have lived aboard since 2021.

20580.title: Hubble Space Telescope
20580.fact: About the size of a school bus. Astronauts visited it **five times** to repair and upgrade it in orbit.

16908.title: Ajisai, the mirror ball
16908.fact: Covered in **318 mirrors**. As it spins it throws flashes of sunlight at the ground, so watch for it twinkling.

3597.title: OAO 2 Space Telescope
3597.fact: One of the **first successful space telescopes**, launched in 1968 to study stars in ultraviolet light the atmosphere blocks.

6153.title: Copernicus Telescope
6153.fact: Named after Nicolaus Copernicus, it launched the year before his **500th birthday**. It studied ultraviolet light from stars until 1981.

3669.title: ISIS 1
3669.fact: A **Canadian** satellite from 1969, built to study the upper atmosphere that bounces radio signals around the world.

4327.title: SERT 2
4327.fact: A NASA test of **ion engines**, which push with a gentle stream of charged gas. The idea now flies on deep-space probes.

5.title: Vanguard 1
5.fact: The **oldest human-made object still in orbit**. Launched in 1958, it will keep circling for centuries.
